approval_status.description: whether the credential has been checked and approved

credential_category.description: the grouping the credential type belongs to

credential_type.description: what the credential is, e.g. a high-risk work licence

credential_type_code.description: the source's code for the credential type

deleted.description: whether the source has deleted the credential

expires_on.description: when the credential stops being valid

expiry_status.description: valid, expired or expiring soon, as the source computed it

external_id.description: the source system's own credential id

holder.description: the worker who holds the credential

is_custom.description: whether the credential type was defined by the tenant rather than the source

issuer.description: the body that issued the credential

reference.description: the source's own reference for the record

refresh_due_on.description: when the credential must be refreshed

registration_number.description: the number printed on the licence or ticket

site.description: the site the credential was recorded against

source_system.description: which bound system emitted the row

training_organisation.description: the registered training organisation that assessed it

updated_at.description: when the record last changed at source
